entities.summary: Matthew Peca is a Canadian professional ice hockey forward for the Syracuse Crunch of the American Hockey League (AHL). He was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the seventh round of the 2011 NHL entry draft. After playing four years at Quinnipiac University, he made his NHL debut during the 2016–17 season.
